answer: Because the haven solution is checked at the karst gate and logged, the tundra audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 19 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Bonded capital sits idle for 8 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
